query_text: what does the word comet mean

messages.content: what does the word comet mean

message.content:
A **comet** is a small icy object in space that orbits the Sun and can develop a glowing head and **tail** when it gets close to the Sun.[1][2][4]

The word can also be used more generally to mean a celestial body that appears as a fuzzy object in the sky.[1][2] It comes from a Greek word meaning *“long-haired star,”* referring to the comet’s tail.[3]
